Overview

Augsburg is a city in Bavaria with a population of 296,000. One of Germany’s oldest cities, a Roman and Renaissance treasure with the Fuggerei, a vibrant cultural scene, and strong industrial roots. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
